global_video_prompt: Premium source-faithful Gloomhaven cinematic with exact original game figures/scenery and shipped GloomhavenVR masks/hands. Warm amber torchlight, restrained cyan/violet original rune accents, rich detailed blacks, coherent scale and lighting. Preserve every input mesh, UV design, card artwork and silhouette. First twelve seconds are filmed at miniature height and look like normal Gloomhaven; no table or VR hints. Giant Grimhorn then an exact hand lift reveal the actual tabletop. Runeveil establishes the second VR player. Text/logo are composited locally.
global_negative_prompt: No changed game architecture, no broken ceiling invented for a sightline, no tabletop edge/hands/masks visible before 12 seconds, no new mask eyes/glows/facial anatomy, no full avatar bodies or extra limbs, no extra fingers, no morphing grip or changing miniature identity, no free physical relocation to another cell, no hand-driven combat, no first-person sword fight or invented hand spells, no remote private card fronts during selection, no replacement card text/art, no generative logos, no aggressive orbit or scale jumps, no generic castle or invented monster.

shots.name: The world you know
shots.motion: One low camera move at original mercenary height through an actual open-topped dungeon/ruin. Original figures remain at board positions. Preserve the impression of a full-scale normal Gloomhaven world for all twelve seconds.
shots.prompt: Actual Gloomhaven original mercenaries and original open dungeon/ruined-chamber scenery, seen at miniature ground level in warm torchlight. Rich stone surface detail and deep passage shadows. Keep all board edges, oversized hands/masks, cards and surrounding-room/table hints completely outside frame. Do not generate generic fantasy figures or change architecture. The overhead reveal sightline must already exist in the chosen source.
shots.capture_reason: Original game scenario geometry and mercenary figures must be extracted read-only or captured. Env_Cellar is a surrounding-environment reference, not proof of an open native scenario or available game figure.
source_requirements: original open-topped dungeon or source-backed unobstructed camera sightline

shots.name: Something above
shots.motion: Camera stays at mercenary height. A source-accurate shadow crosses the original chamber. The giant actual Grimhorn leans into the existing overhead sightline and holds, curious rather than hostile.
shots.prompt: The supplied exact horned carved-wood Grimhorn mask peers down from above the source-backed open dungeon sightline. Seen from tiny mercenary height, the mask is immense. Preserve original horns, carved contours, paint, eye openings and their exact existing albedo; no new eyes or eye glow. Amber torch-side rim, shadow and a restrained head tilt create the reveal. Camera remains low. Do not invent god powers, a body or broken roof. One subtle source-locked motion only.
shots.capture_reason: Must use the same extracted original room and figures as S01, with an existing open sightline.

shots.name: The hand and the scale
shots.motion: Actual glove descends and gently picks an idle original figurine. Camera travels with it past the unchanged board edge into the actual VR tabletop/player relationship. Complete the visual discovery by 26 seconds. Return the figure to its original board cell before native action.
shots.prompt: Rigged source-locked animation using the original five-finger leather glove and original game miniature. Gentle idle pick-up with exact contact and unchanged miniature geometry. Camera follows a deliberate path with the lift; the same dungeon becomes visibly a diorama on the actual table. Grimhorn is a player mask at the source-calibrated VR scale. End the hold and return the figure to its exact original cell. Do not let a generative model invent contact, relocate the figure, resize the miniature or animate freeform combat.
shots.capture_reason: Original figure mesh/material and exact board cell/scale require source extraction or native capture. This critical contact/lift is locally animated.

shots.name: A second presence
shots.motion: Runeveil appears across the table with both arcane hands. Grimhorn answers with a small friendly nod. Hold their relationship, then the shared board.
shots.prompt: The exact ivory Runeveil and both actual arcane glove hands enter opposite the actual Grimhorn and leather-glove hands. Distinct amber/cyan rim light, original Runeveil markings and original eye presentation only. A slight friendly Grimhorn nod communicates another VR player rather than an enemy. Each presence has only its mask and two shipped hands; no bodies. Keep the same table, board, masks and source-calibrated scale.
shots.capture_reason: Maintain the same exact source game board/figure tableau.

shots.name: The choice
shots.motion: Two actual cards per controlled character are considered and committed in coordinated native-tray beats. Source-faithful local/observer angles maintain original privacy.
shots.prompt: Actual physical tactical card selection and two-card tray commitments by the two represented VR players. Exact original game artwork, covered backs, card geometry and shipped glove/arcane rigs. Local controlled-character fronts may be visible. Remote ability-selection fans, held and placed cards remain face-down. Show the shared timing through hand and slot contacts, not an omniscient leak of both selected fronts. Pause at the last contact before native action.
shots.capture_reason: Original native cards, two-card trays, exact selection/commit sequence and local/remote state must be captured or reconstructed from authorized original assets.
shots.privacy: During selection, local controlled-character fronts are open; remote selection cards stay covered. The action-phase reveal occurs only under native rules.

shots.name: The world answers
shots.motion: Three original native action beats from the board. Giant player masks and resting hands frame the same original world in background. Figures begin at their original board cells after release.
shots.prompt: Actual original Gloomhaven action-phase figure movement and effects within the same source diorama. All held figures have returned to their original board cells before native movement. Grimhorn/Runeveil and their exact hands observe in background; hands do not move figures through combat. Preserve game-native figures, abilities and terrain. Three coherent action cuts rather than invented explosions or live-size fighting.
shots.capture_reason: Use actual native action capture or exact original source animation/effects; do not present generated combat as supported gameplay.
shots.privacy: Action-phase cards are face-up under the native presentation rules.
